description:
### YouTube
Features
- Hide chapters in player bottom UI container https://github.com/YT-Advanced/ReX-patches/issues/106, https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/issues/2747. 
- Hide fullscreen button in player

Fixes
- Fix [this issue](https://github.com/YT-Advanced/ReX-patches/issues/106#issuecomment-1968197912) and [this one](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/issues/2178).
- Fix some small bugs.

Both patches are applied during patching process only.
_My patches may have very odd default settings._
